name: Queen's Blade ~Ikusa Otome In'yoku Seisen~
original_name: クイーンズブレード～戦乙女淫欲性戦～
source:
This is a novel adventure game based on the very popular series, "Queen's Blade."

Queen's Blade is a furious battle competition which serves the purpose of picking the queen for the country.
The main character is asked to prevent one of the competitors to be able to qualify to join the competition.
"It's not bad to enjoy the body of well trained body"
He tries to make the girl lose interest in joining the competition and rather lose herself into sexually humiliated pleasure.
